observations: The historical combat plugin registers intent and resolution observers and orders condition, ragdoll and pending melee contact systems; its transient consequence accumulator holds injury, ammunition and equipment contacts. The actual downstream consequence receipt and scheduler authority remain separate dependencies.

Historical melee authority stores an observed windup and active attack, gates target/body-part/time and cooldown, and consumes or transforms the committed state for hit, miss and defensive contact. Ranged authority tracks its own windup and cooldown; cheap gates separately check side, incapacitation, range, facing and permitted timing.

The historical precision owner admits all finite values without a probability clamp, and authority clock arithmetic uses saturating durations. Reachability and behavior at clock exhaustion, every externally admitted intent and finite intermediate need connected review; their existence here is not a current failure finding.
